q1.prompt: You build permutations one slot at a time and undo when a partial path fails. Which method?

wrong_greedy.explanation: Backtracking constructs answers decision by decision and undoes dead ends. A single greedy pass misses other valid permutations.

q2.prompt: Which condition points away from backtracking?

choices.label: On large n without pruning, or when a greedy proof or DP recurrence already solves it
Backtracking always beats DP and greedy

wrong_refuse.explanation: Do not backtrack on large n without pruning — the tree is exponential. Do not choose it when a greedy proof or a DP recurrence already solves the optimization.

success.prompt: You used choose-recurse-undo and avoided unpruned or already-solved cases.
